newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Res Beijing Land IPO 50x subscribed - sources.
newsitem.headline: China Res Beijing Land IPO 50x subscribed - sources.

text.p: The Hong Kong offering of shares in China Resources Beijing Land Ltd, the China property unit spun off by China Resources Enterprise Ltd, is about 50 times subscribed since its initial public offering (IPO) began on Tuesday, market sources said on Wednesday.
The Hong Kong public offer consists of 45 million shares or 15 percent of Beijing Land's total offer of 300 million shares at a price ranging HK$2.18 to HK$2.36 per share.
The remaining 85 percent or 255 million shares is for international placement. The final price is expected to be fixed on close of application on Friday.
Beijing Land is due to release the subscription results on November 6. Dealing in the company shares is expected to begin on November 8.
